hooks.command:
Set-Alias exec Out-Null
exec sh -c 'h="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/coach_hook.py"; m="$1"; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$h" ] || exit 0; case "$OSTYPE" in msys*|cygwin*) c="py python3 python";; *) c="python3 python";; esac; v="import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 9) else 3 if sys.version_info >= (3, 4) else 1)"; f=; g=; for p in $c; do w=$(command -v "$p") || continue; case "$w" in *[Ww][Ii][Nn][Dd][Oo][Ww][Ss][Aa][Pp][Pp][Ss]*) continue;; esac; if [ "$w" = /usr/bin/python3 ] && command -v xcode-select >/dev/null && ! xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; then continue; fi; a=; [ "$p" = py ] && a=-3; "$w" $a -c "$v" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; r=$?; if [ "$r" = 0 ]; then "$w" $a -I "$h" "$m"; exit 0; fi; if [ "$r" = 3 ] && [ -z "$f" ]; then f="$w"; g="$a"; fi; done; if [ -n "$f" ]; then "$f" $g -I "$h" "$m"; fi; exit 0' sh before
$r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if ($r) { $h = Join-Path $r 'hooks/coach_hook.py' } else { $h = '' }; if ($h -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $h -PathType Leaf)) { $v = 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 9) else 3 if sys.version_info >= (3, 4) else 1)'; $f = $null; $g = @(); foreach ($n in 'py', 'python3', 'python') { $c = Get-Command $n -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notmatch '[\\/]WindowsApps[\\/]' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $c) { continue }; $a = @(); if ($n -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; $null = & $c.Source @a -c $v 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $c.Source @a -I $h before; exit 0 }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 3 -and -not $f) { $f = $c.Source; $g = $a } }; if ($f) { & $f @g -I $h before } }; exit 0
